name: Uto (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Uto city emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Uto, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 May 1956.

features.role: Uto city emblem — a ring with two pointed ears at the top
